sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.NCESSchool,
    f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)] DESC
LIMIT 5;

    s.NCESSchool,
    SUM(f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) AS TotalEnrollment

LIMIT 5;
